subject: Stakeholder mapping & next steps (Finovate Bank)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jane Hopkins <jane.hopkins@finovatebank.com>, Carlos Mendez <c.mendez@finovatebank.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 10 Aug 2026 15:05:00 -0700
Subject: Stakeholder mapping & next steps (Finovate Bank)

Hi Jane/Carlos — great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our discovery: 

- Key needs: predictable latency for customer-facing flows, strong audit logs for compliance, and cost predictability for production inference.
- Current constraints: procurement window opens next quarter, legal requires SOC2 + Data Processing Addendum, and procurement will need a draft SOW.

Proposed next steps: 
1) Can you confirm the economic buyer and procurement contact who will own contract/terms?
2) Can we get an intro to your security/legal reviewer so Marcus can run through the SOC2/architecture Qs?
3) I will send a short champion enablement pack (talk track + ROI) you can share internally.

Attached: Redwood_ROI_one-pager.pdf (champion talking points), SOC2-summary.pdf (high level). Im also including a draft SOW template we typically iterate from — happy to tailor.

Would you be available for a 30-min follow-up next week to align stakeholders?

Thanks,
Marissa
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0192

Attachment(s): Redwood_ROI_one-pager.pdf, SOC2-summary.pdf

From: Jane Hopkins <jane.hopkins@finovatebank.com>

Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Stakeholder mapping & next steps (Finovate Bank)

Hi Marissa — thanks for the summary and the materials, super helpful.

Quick answers: 
- Economic buyer is Carlos Mendez (cc'd). He owns the P&L for this product line.
- Procurement contact is Amanda Zhou (legal/procurement); I can intro you but I’ll let Carlos confirm the timing.
- Security reviewer is our Head of Security (internal) but Amanda will coordinate the questionnaire and timeline.

We’re targeting a decision by end of Q4 but procurement typically needs 4–6 weeks once we’re through security. Happy to set a 30-min sync next week — how's Wed 8/18 10am ET?

Best,
Jane
Senior Product Manager | Finovate Bank

Date: Tue, 11 Aug 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Stakeholder mapping & next steps (Finovate Bank)

Thanks Jane — Carlos, great to meet earlier. Quick ask to help move internally: 

- Can you confirm your evaluation criteria (latency SLA, cost per 1k requests, data residency and audit log retention)? If you have any internal scorecard we can align to that would be ideal.
- Would you be open to a 15–20 minute internal enablement call where we arm your champion(s) with one-slide ROI and suggested talk tracks for procurement/legal? I can include Steph and Marcus for finance/security questions.

If it helps, I attached the one-pager for an internal email to the economic buyer and a short agenda for the enablement call. Proposed time: Wed 8/18 10am ET (Jane suggested) — let me know if that works.

Thanks,
Marissa

Hi Marissa — thanks for the materials. Confirming:

- Evaluation criteria: 99th percentile latency under X ms (we’ll share exact target in follow-up), cost per 1k tokens (budget-conscious), and full auditability for production data flows.
- Amanda (cc'd) is our procurement/legal lead — Amanda, can you share the procurement timeline and any standard security questionnaire we should complete?

I’m happy to host an internal enablement session on Wed 8/18 10am ET. Please include the security and finance stakeholders (Marcus for any technical questions is perfect).

Regards,
Carlos
Director, Product (Payments) | Finovate Bank

From: Amanda Zhou <amanda.zhou@finovatebank.com>

Cc: Jane Hopkins <jane.hopkins@finovatebank.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Aug 2026 10:21:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Stakeholder mapping & next steps (Finovate Bank)

Hi Marissa/Carlos — thanks for the intro. Procurement timeline here: once security clears (SOC2 + questionnaire), procurement needs ~3 weeks to review terms and legal to sign. Please provide: 

1) Completed security questionnaire (I’ll attach our standard one when I’m back at my desk).
2) Draft SOW that outlines scope, SLAs, and billing cadence.
3) Any data processing addenda or required certifications.

We prefer DocuSign for signature and usually run Net30 unless a shorter term is agreed. Happy to review the SOW draft; please copy me on any revisions.

Thanks,
Amanda Zhou
Lead, Procurement & Contracts | Finovate Bank
